title: porter rewrite rule
description: One rewrite rule (YAML). A YAML file may hold several rules as separate YAML documents ('---'); each document is validated on its own. A rule without at least one before/after test is rejected. Every rule has a 'replace', except declaration rules (match.declaration), which have an 'edit' instead (RFC 006).

kind.description: mechanical: pure rename/move derived from the symbol graph; adapter: argument/receiver reshaping; idiom: multi-statement or semantic rewrite.

match.description: Exactly one selector. Member selectors use 'Owner#name(ParamType, ...)' with fully qualified owner and simple or qualified parameter types of the 'from' version.

pattern.description: Java code template (RFC 006): one expression, or one or more statements (ending in ';' or '}'). Placeholders: $x = any expression, '$s;' alone = any statement, 'T $v = ...' = the name of a local declared in the pattern. Matched on the AST: type names by simple name, member names also through SRG aliases, casts the pattern does not write and parentheses are ignored.

declaration.description: A declaration in the rewritten sources (RFC 006): type 'a.b.C' ('a.b.C$D' nested), field 'a.b.C#f', method or constructor 'a.b.C#m(ParamType, ...)' ('<init>'). Changed by the rule's 'edit'.

bind.description: Names for matched parts, used as $placeholders in replace.

replace.description: Replacement template in the 'to' version (expression, type name, member name or statements for idioms). May reference bound $placeholders and $target(a.b.C) (a 'to'-version name that --relocate never renames). Empty only for statement patterns (the matched statements are removed).

edit.description: Declaration edits, only with match.declaration (RFC 006). Texts are inserted verbatim and may use $target(a.b.C).

addSupertypes.description: Type: appended to 'implements' (class) or 'extends' (interface); the clause is created when missing.

addMembers.description: Type: text inserted right after the opening brace of the body.

appendMembers.description: Type: text inserted right after the last member (after the opening brace when the body is empty).

initializer.description: Field: the new initializer expression (added when the field has none).

body.description: Method or constructor: the new text between the braces of its body.

remove.description: Member: the declaration is deleted (with its annotations and lines).

imports.description: Imports to add when the rule fires.

preconditions.description: Conditions that must all hold. Vocabulary is owned and documented by the rewriter (rewrite/README.md); unknown conditions make the rule not apply (TODO marker), never apply silently.

priority.description: Higher wins when several rules match the same node.

ref.description: Graph edge, candidate ids, commit URL, etc.

chain.description: For composite rules: ids of the adjacent-pair rules this was composed from, in order.

context.description: Extra declarations/imports needed to type the snippet (e.g. 'Level level; BlockPos pos;').
